description: This file is a test class for the ChartService in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It sets up the test environment, populates test data, and contains test methods to verify the behavior of ChartService methods, such as retrieving a ChartDao instance and getting employee distribution data by subunit.

classes.name: ChartServiceTest

methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit() method for expected distribution data.
